title: Pastoral Analysis
careAlertsTitle: Pastoral follow-up (visible to the team only)
careAlertsHint: A caring call to the family often makes all the difference.
consecutiveAbsencesWarning_one: {{count}} meeting in a row missed — how about a caring call?
consecutiveAbsencesWarning_other: {{count}} meetings in a row missed — how about a caring call?
droppedWarning: Left the class — worth reaching out to understand and welcome
noMeetings: No meetings registered in this class
noMissedThemes: No themes to catch up on — well done!
printFooter: Walking together in faith. With love, the catechesis team.

perfect.title: Congratulations, {{name}}!
perfect.message: You were present at every meeting. Your faithfulness is a beautiful witness for the whole class. Keep it up!

excellent.title: What a joy to walk with you, {{name}}!
excellent.message: You took part in almost every meeting. Your commitment makes a difference and fills our catechesis with life!
excellent.verse: “Where two or three are gathered in my name, there am I among them.” (Mt 18:20)

good.title: Well done, {{name}}!
good.message: You have been taking part steadily. Every meeting is a new chance to grow in faith — we are counting on you!
good.verse: “Blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it.” (Lk 11:28)

missYou.title: {{name}}, the class misses you!
missYou.message: Your place is always saved. We believe in you and look forward to seeing you at the next meeting!
missYou.verse: “Come to me, all you who are weary, and I will give you rest.” (Mt 11:28)

newStart.title: {{name}}, every meeting is a fresh start!
newStart.message: We know life brings challenges. We believe you can do it — at the next meeting we will be waiting for you with open arms!
